Bash(node -e "import\('pg'\).then\(async\({default:pg}\)=>{const{config}=await import\('dotenv'\);config\(\);const p=new pg.Pool\({user:process.env.DBS_USER,password:process.env.DBS_PASSWORD,host:process.env.DBS_HOST,port:process.env.DBS_PORT,database:process.env.DBS_DATABASE,ssl:{rejectUnauthorized:false}}\);const t=\(await p.query\(\\"SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name LIKE 'rem_%' ORDER BY table_name\\"\)\).rows.map\(r=>r.table_name\);console.log\('Tablas rem_*:',t.join\(', '\)\);const c=async x=>\(await p.query\('SELECT count\(*\)::int n FROM '+x\)\).rows[0].n;console.log\('Seeds → afp:',await c\('rem_afp'\),'salud:',await c\('rem_salud'\),'concepto:',await c\('rem_concepto'\),'param:',await c\('rem_parametro_previsional'\),'impuesto_tramo:',await c\('rem_impuesto_tramo'\),'af_tramo:',await c\('rem_asignacion_familiar_tramo'\)\);console.log\('Datos → trabajador:',await c\('rem_trabajador'\),'liquidacion:',await c\('rem_liquidacion'\)\);await p.end\(\);}\)")
